answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1795 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the reef. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the forge queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. The karst index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 212 account operation therefore ties up 32 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
